A place to feel at ease

More than a place to read.

The SMA Citra Berkat Library is a comfortable and welcoming place where students can read, study, and explore new knowledge. Its spacious area and relaxing atmosphere make it a lovely place to spend free time, whether students want to focus on schoolwork or simply enjoy a good book.

One of its special features is the second floor. It offers a quieter and more comfortable environment for students who want to read and enjoy a peaceful moment away from the busier areas.

A relaxing corner for curiosity and learning

Explore Our Book Collection

From learning materials to stories and daily news, students can discover different kinds of reading in one place.

Have a book in mind?

Learning tools & spaces

Facilities That Support Learning

The library combines a comfortable reading environment with useful technology for studying, presentations, and school projects.

Computers

Computers are available to help students work on assignments, study, and access digital learning resources.

Rentable Tablets

Students can rent tablets when they need a device urgently, making it easier to continue their schoolwork.

Smartboard

The smartboard supports presentations and school projects, helping students share ideas and collaborate.

QR Code Attendance

Visitors scan a QR code when they arrive. The system automatically records attendance in the library database.

Simple & student-friendly

Take a book home and enjoy it.

Students can borrow up to three books at a time and keep them for one week. This gives everyone time to read at their own pace, enjoy a story, or use a book to support their studies.

Need a quick answer?

Library FAQ

A few helpful things to know before your next visit.

How many books can I borrow?

Students can borrow up to three books at a time.

How long can I keep borrowed books?

The borrowing period is one week.

Can I request a book that is not available?

Yes. You can tell the librarian about a title you would like the library to purchase.

Is there a quieter place to read?

Yes. The second floor offers a quieter and more comfortable reading space.

A supportive learning space

Read. Learn. Collaborate. Create.

With its spacious atmosphere, wide range of reading materials, and helpful facilities, the SMA Citra Berkat Library is more than just a place to read. It is a supportive learning space where students can study, collaborate, discover new ideas, and develop their creativity.

Connecting the attendance system

To activate real attendance, we will need the school's approved API endpoint, the QR code format or scanner requirements, and permission to send student identifiers securely. These details should come from the school administrator. This website currently only provides the interface.

Next technical step: connect a secure backend endpoint (for example, /api/attendance/check-in) and validate each scan on the server.
